name: Risk Warning Callout
when_to_pick: Drop in the mandated compliance risk disclosure on any post or glossary term that discusses signals, backtests, win rates, leverage, or live trading outcomes. Use it once near the relevant claim (not decoratively); it carries a warning-styled box and a required link to the host's risk-warning page. Prefer this over a hand-written warning callout whenever the copy is a regulatory risk disclosure.

heading.description: Short callout title. Defaults to 'Risk Warning'.

body.description: The risk disclosure copy. Trusted inline HTML is allowed (rendered with |safe) — keep it to simple <strong>/<em> emphasis. Must avoid guaranteed-profit / risk-free / can't-lose language.

link_text.description: Anchor text for the mandatory risk-warning link. The href comes from the host's KEEL_UI['risk_warning_url'] config (defaults to /risk-warning).
